admissible_class: ADM_E(r)=target fixed-length turn resolvers satisfying A0-A7 plus A8 Primitive-Support Frontier Maximality
domain: every integer r>=1 and every fixed endpoint O

claims.N_membership: The accepted AK turn operator satisfies A0-A7 by AK and A8 because AH/AG identify its first-sector path with the outer frontier of K_E(r).
claims.sector_uniqueness: For every r>=1, ADM_E^sector(r) has exactly one endpoint path. Starting at (r,0), the first-difference induction forces the outward supported successor when available and otherwise forces the unique inward-diagonal supported successor; D6/reflection fixes the bisector crossing.
claims.sector_identity: The unique sector path is exactly W_N(r) / the AK local-turn endpoint sequence.
claims.full_orbit_uniqueness: A5 D6 covariance transports the unique sector path to all six sectors; A6-A7 fix the joins/orientation, so the full simple orbit is uniquely the accepted AK/AH N D6 boundary.
claims.turn_representation: Different internal register encodings may represent the same unique endpoint resolver; uniqueness is geometric/orbit-level, not a claim of unique machine encoding.
claims.period: The unique orbit has minimal positive turn period T_r=C_N(r)=6*(r+J_N(r)).
claims.constant: Its native asymptotic period/transition-span constant is kappa_E with kappa_E^2=12 and kappa_E>0.

proof_kernel: Q_E and support_rank construct K_E(r) without the N word or recurrence.
AG gives the coordinate certificate support_rank=9q-9max+3 and the left/right monotonicity/closure inequalities.
Those inequalities make K_E(r) sectorwise downward closed with one outer monotone frontier.
At a first proposed divergence from that frontier, an outward move is either unsupported (inadmissible) or supported (so choosing the inward move violates A8). Therefore divergence is impossible.
D6 covariance upgrades sector uniqueness to full-orbit uniqueness.
canonicality_scope: Unique within the explicitly frozen non-tautological target-native admissible class ADM_E. AL does not claim to classify all imaginable rules that reject one of these native axioms.
runtime_firewall: The canonical runtime remains the AK constant-size integer tau; support_rank/Q_E are proof/admissibility structures and are not evaluated by tau at runtime.
